title: Step 4's draws of exp-concepts-controller-54 against BBRv3
description: The comparison with BBRv3 that exp-concepts-controller-54 was written to make and did not: its cells kept each draw's policy but did not run it on the validation episodes, so its versus-bbr3 had no rollouts of the draws and reads every draw as not trained well, unmeasured (experiments/concepts-controller.json's cells now run them, and versus_reference.py refuses a run without them). One cell streams only the setup and the sixteen kept draws (ctl-*) out of that release, runs each draw's policy.onnx (net1 and net2 in one graph, the window fixed, as the trainer's evaluation runs it) on the validation episodes of exp-teachers-val-35 with ground.py rollouts from the release's own setup (the training links cut to one episode), and sets each draw against BBRv3 on the same episodes with experiments/versus_reference.py. Rule, as fixed in that experiment before any draw was scored: a draw is trained well when the whole 95% interval of its log utility minus BBRv3's lies above -0.1, alone and with a competing flow; the concepts work at m = all when a concept draw is trained well. The test links are not read.
run: E="$(mktemp -d)"; for r in "$IN/controller"/ctl-*; do R="${r##*/}"; mkdir -p "$OUT/$R"; cp "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$r/policy.onnx" "$OUT/$R/"; uv run python experiments/ground.py rollouts "$OUT/$R" --links 1 --fit "$IN/controller/setup/paths/campaign.json" --score "$IN/controller/setup/eval/campaign.json" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; ln -s "$OUT/$R" "$E/$R-s1"; done; uv run python experiments/versus_reference.py "$OUT/versus-bbr3" "$E"/* "$IN/teachers"/stock-*
